$comment: Lighthouse lab budgets per template (docs/seo/AUDIT.md, DECISIONS 15). One URL stands for each template. Mobile emulation with simulated throttling, against a local production build. They guard against regressions; the Core Web Vitals targets (LCP <= 2.5 s, INP <= 200 ms, CLS <= 0.1 at p75) are field targets, measured by Speed Insights. Simulated LCP on a local server counts every early request against the LCP, so it reads about 1.5 s higher than applied throttling (2.1 s on 16 Oct 2026). TBT stands in for INP in the lab.

home.$comment: The homepage carries the hero motion and the most JavaScript (about 231 KB). Simulated LCP is 3.9 to 4.1 s; applied-throttling LCP is about 2.1 s (DECISIONS 15).
